title: Curious Baby Crawling on Floral Pattern Sofa, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming mid-century black and white snapshot capturing an infant during tummy time, propped up on forearms and peering curiously over the arm or cushion of an upholstered sofa featuring a delicate floral pattern. The soft domestic lighting and candid pose exemplify mid-20th-century family snapshots documenting developmental milestones of early childhood at home.
